errorRate.title: Call error rate
errorRate.hint: Failed calls as a share of the model's calls. Internal retries of the same candidate model count once.

tps.title: Generation speed
tps.hint: Output speed weighted by streaming time, excluding the first token. Requires the provider to report output tokens.

ttft.title: Time to first token
ttft.hint: Average time from sending a request to receiving the first text, reasoning, or tool output.

trendDaily: {title} by day. Use the left and right arrow keys to read values.
trendHourly: {title} by hour. Use the left and right arrow keys to read values.
title: Model call performance
noTtft: No first-token latency samples in this period
noTps: No generation speed samples in this period
selectedHour: Selected hour; the last hour by default
selectedDay: Selected day; the last day by default
